title: Chaos Garden request event, version 1
description: One proxied request. Published by chaos-garden-proxy to the Redis Stream (field `data`, JSON), consumed by the ingest service. Version 1 may only gain new optional properties; consumers must ignore properties they don't know.

id.description: Unique per request; consumers use it to ignore duplicates.

path.description: Path on the target, without the query string.

status.description: Status sent to the client, or null when no response was sent.

completed.description: False when the connection closed before the response finished.

faults.description: Faults applied, in order. Known values: latency, error, drop, corrupt, rate_limited. Consumers must tolerate unknown values.

ruleIds.description: Ids of the rules that fired.

requestId.description: The request's x-request-id. Optional (added after the first release of v1).
